p: Use Hanzo AI in Go using the official OpenAI Go client or any OpenAI-compatible Go library. Hanzo's standard REST API works with all HTTP clients.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: BSD-3-Clause · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing Go code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the Go Authors / Google team for building and maintaining this open-source project.
